subject: music

moments.title: Rite of Spring premiere
moments.who: Igor Stravinsky and Vaslav Nijinsky, Paris
moments.body: The premiere at the Theatre des Champs-Elysees provokes a famous riot, with audience members fighting in the aisles.
moments.takeaway: Modernism's most cited scandal was as much about choreography as score.

moments.title: Schoenberg's twelve-tone method
moments.body: Schoenberg articulates serialism, organising music around 12 equal pitch classes.
moments.takeaway: Composers tried to escape tonality through formal systems.

moments.title: Stravinsky dies
moments.body: Stravinsky's career spans late Romantic, neoclassical and serial phases.
moments.takeaway: Major composers can change idiom every decade.

now.title: Modernism in repertoire
now.body: The Rite is now one of the most-performed 20th-century works. Schoenberg remains less popular but central to teaching.
now.open_questions: What makes one piece of modernism catch on and another not?

reflection: Audience riots over music are rare and revealing.
